_read_this_first: No third-party source is committed to this repository. `repos` is empty until someone deliberately runs benchmarks/vendor.py, which fetches permissively licensed code only on explicit invocation and writes a NOTICE.md per repo. See docs/08-benchmarks.md.

smoke.description: Hermetic pipeline check: fast, deterministic, no network, no third-party code. Proves the engine and the harness — never model quality.

repo_scale.description: Multi-step, cross-file tasks with a test_command at the end. Meaningful only when run with a real provider; under the canned provider its quality checks are reported as skipped rather than passed.

tasks.title: Add a banner file
tasks.description: Create banner.txt at the repository root containing the word BENCH.

tasks.title: Write a NOTES.md
tasks.description: Create NOTES.md at the repository root summarising the module.

tasks.title: Rename greet to welcome everywhere
tasks.description: Rename the function greet to welcome across src/app.py and tests/test_app.py. Both call sites and the import must be updated, and the test suite must still pass afterwards.

tasks.title: Make shout lowercase-tolerant
tasks.description: Add a module-level __all__ to src/app.py listing greet and shout, and keep the test suite green.

tasks.title: Add a whisper function
tasks.description: Add a function whisper(name) to src/app.py that returns the greeting in lower case, so whisper('WORLD') returns 'hello world'. Add a test for it to tests/test_app.py.

argv: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from app import whisper; assert whisper('WORLD') == 'hello world'

tasks.title: Give greet a default argument
tasks.description: Give greet a default argument so that calling greet() with no arguments returns 'hello world', while greet('bob') still returns 'hello bob'.

argv: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from app import greet; assert greet() == 'hello world' and greet('bob') == 'hello bob'

tasks.title: Add a VERSION constant
tasks.description: Add a module-level constant VERSION = "0.1.0" to src/app.py.

argv: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import app; assert app.VERSION == '0.1.0'

tasks.title: Add a util module with clamp
tasks.description: Create src/util.py containing a function clamp(value, low, high) that returns value limited to the range low..high, so clamp(5, 0, 3) is 3, clamp(-1, 0, 3) is 0 and clamp(2, 0, 3) is 2.

argv: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from util import clamp; assert (clamp(5, 0, 3), clamp(-1, 0, 3), clamp(2, 0, 3)) == (3, 0, 2)

tasks.title: Document usage in the README
tasks.description: Add a section headed '## Usage' to README.md that shows how to call greet.

tasks.title: Make shout exclaim
tasks.description: Make shout end with an exclamation mark, so shout('world') returns 'HELLO WORLD!', and update its test to match.

argv: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from app import shout; assert shout('world') == 'HELLO WORLD!'

tasks.title: Remove shout
tasks.description: Delete the shout function from src/app.py and delete its test from tests/test_app.py, leaving greet and its test in place.

argv: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import app; assert not hasattr(app, 'shout') and hasattr(app, 'greet')

tasks.title: Add a word_count function
tasks.description: Add a function word_count(text) to src/app.py that returns the number of whitespace-separated words in text, so word_count('a b  c') is 3 and word_count('') is 0.

argv: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from app import word_count; assert (word_count('a b  c'), word_count('')) == (3, 0)

tasks.title: Start a changelog
tasks.description: Create a CHANGELOG.md at the repository root with a heading and an entry for version 0.1.0.
